sources.title: Muse Glimmer | Meta
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer An open model built for always-on local agents. 30B parameters, licensed under Apache 2.0 and runs on a single GPU — tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer — Meta's 30B AI Model for Your Laptop
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer is Meta's open-weight 30B model that runs on one consumer GPU. Free on Hugging Face, agentic capable, and built for local-first AI workflows.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model - ai.meta.com
sources.snippet: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer 30B — AI Model | MindStudio
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B is a 30-billion-parameter language model developed by Meta, classified as a multimodal chat model capable of processing both text and images. It is hosted through DeepInfra and is available on MindStudio without requiring separate API key setup.
